scope: All 16 previously reviewed monthly VPS.TC mappings

structural_changes.field: default quantities and displayed selected quantity

unchanged: The private comparison reported no other form-field changes; product terms fingerprints remained valid.
interpretation: The supplier reduced the snapshot control's included/default baseline from two to one. This is a commercial configuration change, not cosmetic or JSON key order drift.
unresolved: Current per-unit prices and a read-only explicit quantity-two calculation are required to establish whether a second snapshot incurs an extra fee. dontchargedefault=1 alone does not prove quantity two remains free.
recovery_options: Supplier restores the reviewed two-slot baseline; re-read all forms and validate existing hashes and full explicit quotes before normal price publication.
Owner explicitly approves revised one-slot commercial terms; fully review and bind a new mapping and customer-facing terms before any publication.
If the supplier supports a paid second slot, implement and validate its current recurring procurement cost and disclosed commercial terms before approving a two-slot offer.
diagnostic_boundary: The fixed POST /api/quote endpoint may calculate exact quantity-one and quantity-two configurations. It must not be replaced by an order, payment, renewal, provisioning or synchronization call. A diagnostic quote does not approve a changed offer.
sensitive_data: Account fingerprints, authentication material, raw form bodies, native customer/service/invoice identifiers and private artifact paths are omitted.
